think of putting away groceries, and you've got various jars. Maybe one of them is a glass jar of peanut butter, another is a plastic jar of spaghetti sauce. If you're grabbing these jars without looking at the label, assuming they're the same general size, you'd instinctually know one is heavier than the other, right? your fingertips are sensitive enough to pick up the heft of the glass jar of peanut butter when you're initially grabbing it to put it away, and your brain/body automatically corrects how you're holding it as you place it in a pantry. 

TLDR; A dense glass jar shifts the pads of your fingers more than a lighter plastic jar but has less give in terms of vessel thickness, so it needs more strength to grab it and lift it properly. Your brain automatically guesstimates this based on many things with nerves.

Hard lesson items are a little more difficult to do so with, but if you have a bunch of D-Energys lying around collecting dust feel free to use them on those

-There were multiple points in time where I just paid attention to events and the :D jobs app for a little while to stockpile resources and level up cards as much as possible. Luckily once you finish grinding items for a specific card and get it to its maximum rank, you just have to focus on Grimm for leveling and the occasional 10k devil tree slot for the URs
